text:
lee: Heads-up: we're enabling strict-signer enforcement on router (reject unsigned X-User-Sig) for internal routes. Impacts API and runtime header passthrough. Target change window: Fri 23:00-23:30 UTC. Low-risk but auth rejects possible.
toni: Can we pin versions for the window and run a 5% canary first? I want API pinned and console frozen.
lee: Plan: router -> 4.0.0-beta1, api -> 1.15.0, runtime no binary change but feature flag `--header-sig-mode=strict` enabled. Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> manual roll to 100%. Smoke tests @ +5m.
jamal: Paste the rollback commands so oncall can act quick if 5xx or auth errors spike.
lee: Rollback cmds: `deployctl traffic swap --service router --from 4.0.0-beta1 --to 3.9.8 --instant` and `deployctl feature unset --service runtime --flag header-sig-mode`
deploy-bot: pin created: {service: router, version: "4.0.0-beta1", window: "2026-04-02T23:00:00Z/2026-04-02T23:30:00Z"} :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: pin created: {service: api, version: "1.15.0", window: "2026-04-02T23:00:00Z/2026-04-02T23:30:00Z"} :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Quiet-window scheduled at 22:50 UTC. Autoscaler warmup disabled for 15m. Alert rule added: router/auth_errors > 3/min -> notify #eng-oncall and this thread.
qa-bot: Preflight smoke job queued: router-sign-check-quick, api-auth-flow, runtime-kv-smoketest.
toni: I'll hold console at v0.9.4. No hot swaps.
lee: Canary start: runtime flag to 5% (header-sig-mode=strict) and router 5% traffic to beta.
deploy-bot: runtime flag staged to 5% canary (group runtime-canary-a).
deploy-bot: router traffic slice 5% -> 4.0.0-beta1.
qa-bot: smoke report: api-auth-flow failing on ~8% of requests with 401 (missing signed header). Repro steps attached.
jamal: That's bad. Are these from legacy SDKs or internal infra? Need sample logs.
lee: Looking: failed requests show `X-User-Sig` absent for some internal calls from console-proxy. Console devs pushed a change last week that'll add sig later this month.
toni: Oof. Console freeze prevents patch. Can we temporary relax router to allow unsigned for routes with `X-Debug-Client`?
jamal: Short-term fix idea: update router policy to `allow-if-unsigned: internal/legacy/*` and re-run canary, or roll router back to 3.9.8. Which is faster?
lee: Given traffic pattern and several 401s, safest is rollback router to 3.9.8, then revert runtime flag. We'll abort rollout.
deploy-bot: executing traffic swap: router 4.0.0-beta1 -> 3.9.8 by jamal at 23:12 UTC.
ops-bot: Alert cleared: router/auth_errors back to baseline.
qa-bot: Re-run smoke: api-auth-flow now OK. Runtime KV and latency stable.
lee: Reverted runtime flag across canaries at 23:15.
deploy-bot: runtime feature unset: header-sig-mode removed.
toni: I'll note console compatibility issue in release notes and open a ticket to add signed header to console-proxy: CE-4042.
jamal: Filing follow-up: add a preflight test that simulates legacy console calls, and add a canary gate for auth failure rate.
lee: Summary: attempted strict-signer release, pinned API/router, started 5% canary, observed auth failures from console-proxy, rolled router back to 3.9.8, removed runtime flag, smoke pass. Closing window.
toni: Will draft a short postmortem and updated release checklist tomorrow. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
